ods.name: Primary Baseline OD
ods.description: Baseline primary route OD traversing mixed farmland, road, and offroad terrain.

ods.name: Forest Rowspacing Boundary OD
ods.description: Crosses forest boundary with varying tree rowspacing to test vehicle safe width passability.

ods.name: Water and Low-Lying Gully OD
ods.description: Crosses water bodies and low-lying drainage gullies to test water depth clearance and rain weather impedance.

ods.name: Road and Offroad Soil Interface OD
ods.description: Transitions between paved road network and offroad soil corridors to test road width and soil properties.

ods.name: Steep Slope Traverse OD
ods.description: Traverses steep terrain (approx 30 deg slope) to test pitch and roll angle decoupling.
